messages.en: What time are we heading back to Kedah tomorrow? I'm just worried about getting stuck in traffic.
Let's head north a bit earlier. Is six okay?
Sure. Message me as soon as you get here. I'll come straight down.
The van's here downstairs. Let's go down.
Just a sec, let me grab my bag first.

senses.en_definition: A recording of moving images, usually with sound, for playback on a screen.
A device for recording and playing back videotapes through a television.
Magnetic tape used to record moving images and sound.

messages.en: Have you sent the video of us singing last night yet?
Yep, I sent it to the group earlier. Watch it when you're free—your bit is the funniest 😂
The doctor says I've got a viral infection, so I'm going to rest at home for now.
Okay, get some rest. I've already let the team leader know.
